use_when: 在移动App渗透测试中需要对Android/iOS应用开展抓包、攻击面枚举与本地数据利用时阅读本篇，重点涵盖Frida/Objection Hook脚本、SSL Pinning绕过、导出组件、WebView RCE、Intent重定向、Keychain提取与Root/Play Integrity检测绕过，区别于后端API与纯Web端漏洞测试。

section_map.heading: 1. SSL PINNING BYPASS
section_map.what: Frida多Hook点通用绕过、Objection一键禁用、Network Security Config与Magisk/LSPosed模块四条安卓抓包路径

section_map.heading: 2. COMPONENT EXPOSURE
section_map.what: adb与aapt枚举导出Activity/Provider/Receiver/Service并利用SQL注入、路径穿越与恶意广播

section_map.heading: 3. WEBVIEW VULNERABILITIES
section_map.what: addJavascriptInterface反射RCE、file域同源绕过与深链到WebView的XSS调用JS桥攻击链

section_map.heading: 4. INTENT REDIRECTION
section_map.what: Intent-in-Intent转发放大漏洞，借导出组件启动非导出内部Activity或打开任意URL

section_map.heading: 6. PLAY INTEGRITY / SAFETYNET BYPASS
section_map.what: Zygisk DenyList、PIF模块伪造设备指纹与Shamiko隐藏root对抗完整性校验

section_map.heading: 7. TAPJACKING (OVERLAY ATTACKS)
section_map.what: 透明悬浮窗Activity覆盖界面诱导误触及各安卓版本防护差异与绕过

section_map.heading: 8. BACKUP EXTRACTION
section_map.what: 利用allowBackup默认开启通过adb backup提取SharedPreferences与SQLite中的令牌凭据

section_map.heading: 10. ANDROID PENTESTING DECISION TREE
section_map.what: 从抓包绕过、组件、WebView、Intent到root检测的全流程测试路径决策图

section_map.heading: 3. METHOD TRACER
section_map.what: Frida批量trace目标类所有方法入参与返回值以理解应用逻辑

section_map.heading: 4. CRYPTO HOOK (KEY & PLAINTEXT EXTRACTION)
section_map.what: Hook Cipher.init/doFinal、SecretKeySpec与MessageDigest抓取加密密钥、明文及哈希运算

section_map.heading: 8. BIOMETRIC BYPASS
section_map.what: Hook BiometricPrompt认证回调压制失败事件强行通过指纹/面容认证

section_map.heading: 1. JAILBREAK VS NON-JAILBREAK TESTING
section_map.what: 越狱与非越狱设备测试能力差异及重签名注入Frida gadget的非越狱Hook方案

section_map.heading: 2. KEYCHAIN EXTRACTION
section_map.what: 钥匙串各保护等级风险评估与keychain-dumper/Objection提取密码令牌手法
